meta.title: 6-Day Marrakech, Sahara Desert & Fes Tour | Shared Morocco Adventures
meta.description: A 6-day one-way group tour from Marrakech to Fes — Ait Benhaddou, the Dades Gorges, a Merzouga desert camp, then guided sightseeing in Fes. From €412pp.
meta.ogDescription: A shared, one-way group tour from Marrakech to Fes via the High Atlas, Ait Benhaddou, the Dades Gorges and a Sahara desert camp at Merzouga. From €412pp.

hero.lead: Marrakech → Ait Benhaddou → Dades Gorges → Merzouga Desert Camp → Fes

overview.h2: Cross the Sahara and finish in Fes
paras: Our most-booked Sahara route, extended one-way into Fes instead of looping back to Marrakech: airport pick-up and a night in Marrakech, the High Atlas passes and Berber valleys, a camel trek and overnight desert camp at Merzouga, then a scenic drive north to two nights in Fes with a full day of guided medina sightseeing.
Transport, driver-guide, and accommodation are shared across the group, which keeps the per-person cost far below a private itinerary covering the same route.

days.label: Arrive
days.title: Arrival in Marrakech
paras: Pick-up from Marrakech Menara Airport (RAK) and transfer to your hostel in the medina. The rest of the day is free to explore Jemaa el-Fnaa square and the surrounding souks — this is also your chance to meet the rest of the group before departure the next morning.

days.label: Dades
days.title: Marrakech to Dades Gorges
paras: Early morning group departure from the hostel. Cross the High Atlas via the Tizi n'Tichka pass, stop at the Ait Benhaddou kasbah (a UNESCO World Heritage site), and continue through the Valley of Roses to an overnight stay in the Dades Gorges.

days.label: Desert
days.title: Dades Gorges to Merzouga Desert
paras: Drive on via Tinghir and Erfoud to Merzouga, gateway to the Sahara. Late afternoon camel ride into the Erg Chebbi dunes, arriving at your desert camp in time for sunset — dinner around the fire, live music, and a night under the stars.

days.label: Fes
days.title: Merzouga to Fes
paras: Optional sunrise over the dunes before camels carry the group back to Merzouga. Full day's drive north via Er-Rachidia, Midelt and the Middle Atlas cedar forests to Fes. Overnight in Riad Fez Mahal or La Perle de la Medina.

days.label: Fes
days.title: Fes sightseeing with a local guide
paras: Full guided day through the Fes el-Bali medina — the Chouara tanneries, the souks, and the Bou Inania Madrasa. Overnight in the same Fes riad.

days.label: Depart
days.title: Transfer to Fes Airport
paras: Free morning depending on flight time, then transfer from your Fes riad to Fes-Saïss Airport (FEZ) for departure. Trip ends.

cards.title: Night 1 · Marrakech
html: Riad Dia, immediately next to Jemaa el-Fnaa — 9.3/10 on Hostelworld, rooftop pool, free breakfast and WiFi. Backup: Hostel Riad Marrakech Rouge, 2 minutes from the square.

cards.title: Night 2 · Dades Gorges
html: Luxury Dades Riad or Auberge Tissadrin, half board (HB) — a kasbah-style riad in the Dades Valley with mudbrick rooms, terrace gorge views, and dinner included.

cards.title: Night 3 · Merzouga desert camp
html: Ideal Desert Camp, half board (HB) — a Berber-style camp at the edge of the Erg Chebbi dunes with dinner and breakfast included, campfire music, and a night under the stars.

cards.title: Nights 4–5 · Fes
html: Riad Fez Mahal or La Perle de la Medina — traditional medina riads with courtyard rooms, a short walk from the Fes el-Bali sights.

notes: Confirm current availability directly before booking — allocation shifts seasonally.

includes: Airport pick-up and transfer to hostel (Day 1)
Shared transport in an air-conditioned minivan
Camel ride and 1 night at the desert camp
Local guide for Fes medina sightseeing (Day 5)
Breakfast daily and 2 dinners (half board at Dades Gorges & desert camp)
excludes: Entrance fees to Fes medina sites (tanneries, madrasas)
Private rooms (available on request, extra cost)

paras: Groups are capped at 16 travelers to keep things sociable without losing the personal touch. Departures run every Saturday year-round — reserve early in peak season (October–April) as routes sell out.
Because this route ends in Fes rather than looping back to Marrakech, it's a good fit if you're continuing north to Chefchaouen or flying out of Fes-Saïss Airport.
Prefer the desert loop back to Marrakech instead? See our 4-Day Sahara Desert Group Tour. Want more time in the north before you fly out? See our 8-Day Marrakech, Sahara, Fes & Chefchaouen Tour.
Booking terms: Send an enquiry first; we confirm the departure, final price, and payment instructions by email. No payment is taken through this website.

items.q: Is this trip one-way, or does it return to Marrakech?
items.a: One-way — you're picked up in Marrakech on Day 1 and dropped off in Fes on Day 6, so there's no long drive back across the Atlas at the end.

Yes — the €412 price is based on shared twin/dorm rooms in Marrakech, the Dades Gorges and Fes, and a shared tent at the desert camp. A private room upgrade is available on request for an additional cost.

items.q: What should I pack for the desert night?
items.a: Desert nights get cold even in summer — bring a warm layer, plus sunscreen, a scarf or hat for wind and sun, and comfortable walking shoes.

items.q: Is the Fes sightseeing day guided?
items.a: Yes — Day 5 includes a full day with a local guide through the Fes el-Bali medina, covering the tanneries, souks and the Bou Inania Madrasa.

items.q: Can I extend this into Chefchaouen and the Middle Atlas?
items.a: Yes — see our 8-Day Marrakech, Sahara, Fes & Chefchaouen Tour, which adds a Chefchaouen day trip and a Middle Atlas/Ifrane day trip from Fes before your final departure.

items.q: What if the group doesn't fill up?
items.a: Departures run on fixed weekly dates regardless of group size — your trip runs even if only a few seats are booked.
